sources.supports: U214 Cap-Bus pin 8 is LoRa reset, pin 10 is BUSY input and the shared radio uses SPI
current official U219 pin map: pin 3 SCL, pin 4 SDA, pin 8 POWER_EN, pin 10 NFC_CS, shared SPI, CC1101 and ST25R3916; pin 7 remains blank/ambiguous
M5 example selects ST25R3916 SPI mode 1 at 10 MHz
CC1101 SPI commands, strobes, MCSM0 pin control and MCSM1 automatic post-RX states
ST25R3916 SPI and 13.56-MHz reader field behavior
MIT-licensed reference API; U219 support is marked for future use and is not integrated here

reset_and_unknown.reason: the same defaults hold U214 in reset, keep U219 POWER_EN fail-low and prevent back-power before a signed profile is verified

selection.unknown_or_invalid_result: remain off in U214-safe reset defaults
selection.profile_change_requires: full shutdown, I/O isolation and a fresh signed-profile verification

profiles.tx_policy: unchanged: stock U214 remains receive/GNSS-only because it has no qualified physical TX evidence

profiles.scope: optional CC1101 receive plus NFC reader/poller
profiles.nfc_policy: poll and read only; write and card emulation are forbidden
profiles.tx_policy: CC1101 TX is forbidden; the NFC reader field requires its own physical-field lease and evidence

power_and_direction_sequence: verify exactly one signed profile while branch power and I/O connection remain off
preload both chip selects high; keep pin 8 low; set pin 10 input for U214 or output-high behind disabled isolation for U219
enable the protected Cap power branch while all external I/O remains isolated
after qualified power-good, connect the no-back-power I/O boundary while pin 8 remains low
raise pin 8 to release U214 reset or enable U219 only after the previous steps
on reset, fault, profile mismatch or shutdown: lower pin 8, deselect SPI, isolate I/O and remove branch power

shared_spi.rule: both chip selects must be high before a target or SPI mode changes; exactly one target may be selected

contracts.status: existing target adapter ceiling remains unchanged

imported_hardware_boundary.authority: pre-H2 working hardware contract; not ECAD, target adapter or HIL closure

contacts.boundary: return buffer; U214 active-high, U219 polarity remains received-unit HIL

imported_hardware_boundary.contact_7: official-source ambiguity; no usable firmware signal and accessory power remains a received-unit gate

register_write_rules: MCSM0.PIN_CTRL_EN must remain zero so a CS edge cannot synthesize STX
MCSM1.RXOFF_MODE may select IDLE or RX only; FSTXON and TX are rejected
every byte of a burst must pass the same address/value filter before the transaction starts

compile_gate.result: no current target build can enable the 13.56-MHz field

nfc_reader.runtime_gate: a reviewed VNA/HIL capability attestation plus an active physical-evidence lease are both mandatory
gate_closure_requires: actual U219 sample and final enclosure
pickup-loop VNA tuning and detector threshold closure
assert/clear latency and no-false-negative field evidence

dependency_policy.rule: retain the existing permissive-license-only product dependency policy

evaluated_not_integrated.status: reference only, not integrated; no source vendored or linked

evaluated_not_integrated.name: RadioLib
evaluated_not_integrated.status: candidate only, not integrated; no source vendored or linked

known_open_hardware_gates: the official U219 page is work in progress and its public pin table exposes RF_SW0 while its band truth table also names RF_SW1
the exact production U219 revision, signed identity binding, contact-7 power continuity and RF_SW1 implementation remain received-unit gates
EV_N9 pickup geometry, tuning, threshold and physical timing remain VNA/HIL evidence
no target, dev-board or Leshy2 HIL run is claimed by this host policy

implementation.hardware_contract_scope: H1-R2.31 exact pre-H2 pins only; no target/HIL claim
